categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily manufactures power cords, wire harnesses, power supply peripherals, plastic injection parts, sockets, adapters, and electronic product assembly services. It serves consumer electronics, electrical appliances, computer peripherals, and industrial applications including low earth orbit satellites and electric vehicles. The company also develops IoT-related smart home products under its own brands.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced manufacturing technologies including automated production lines and robotic automation to improve efficiency and reduce labor costs. It develops proprietary molds and integrates vertical production processes from raw material procurement to finished products. The company focuses on environmentally friendly materials, low-smoke halogen-free substances, and complies with multiple international safety certifications.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include domestic and international manufacturers in the computer, home appliance, consumer electronics, telecommunications, and automotive sectors. Major end markets are in the Americas, Asia, and Europe, with significant sales to OEMs and branded product companies. The company also targets emerging markets such as electric vehicle charging infrastructure and IoT smart home devices.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations and sales cover Taiwan, China (including Dongguan and Kunshan), Vietnam, the United States, and Japan. The company has production facilities in Taiwan, China, and plans to expand manufacturing in the US and Vietnam to mitigate tariff risks and serve local markets. Sales are distributed globally with a focus on Asia, Americas, and Europe.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the electronics supply chain, manufacturing power cords, connectors, and related components. It integrates upstream activities such as mold development and raw material processing, and downstream activities including product assembly and direct sales to OEMs and end customers. It also provides ODM and OEM services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include developing environmentally friendly and halogen-free materials, miniaturized and modular power cords, and smart IoT-enabled products with wireless and Bluetooth control. The company invests in automation and proprietary production equipment to enhance manufacturing efficiency. It aims to expand its own brands and increase market penetration in electric vehicle and satellite communication sectors.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of power cords, adapters, connectors, and electronic assemblies. The company also earns income from ODM/OEM manufacturing contracts and branded product sales. It leverages diversified product lines and geographic markets to sustain revenue growth.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company positions itself as a leading professional manufacturer of power cords and related electronic components in Taiwan with strong international presence. It competes by offering high-quality, certified products with rapid development cycles and flexible production capabilities. Competitors include other global and regional power cord and connector manufacturers, but the company differentiates through vertical integration and innovation.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In fiscal year 113 (2024), the company reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$5.92 billion, an 11.14% increase from the previous year, and a net profit of NT$723 million, up 42.55%. The company maintains a stable growth trajectory with expanding production capacity and investments in automation and overseas facilities. It has a solid financial structure with increasing retained earnings and equity.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high product quality, compliance with multiple international safety standards, and rapid customization capabilities to meet diverse customer needs. Its vertical integration from raw materials to finished products enables cost control and innovation. The focus on environmentally friendly materials, automation, and smart IoT solutions provides competitive differentiation and aligns with global sustainability trends.
